findings.title: Goroutine leaks when the context is cancelled before Poll returns
findings.description: ch is unbuffered and only received from in the select; if ctx is cancelled first, Next returns and the goroutine blocks forever on `ch <- ev` after Poll returns, leaking one goroutine per cancelled call. Make the channel buffered (make(chan Event, 1)) so the send never blocks.
findings.suggestion: Use `ch := make(chan Event, 1)` so the producer goroutine can always complete its send.
